t: You're looking at the Four Apostles, a group of statues carved by Grinling Gibbons and Arnold Quellin. Gibbons was an Anglo-Dutch sculptor and wood carver, whose work you can find at St Paul's Cathedral, Hampton Court Palace and the Royal Hospital Chelsea. Quellin was a Flemish sculptor, trained in Antwerp, who worked mostly in London. The two worked in partnership on some commissions, and it is not always certain which of them made which piece, so these figures are best thought of as the work of both.
